note: Figures are affected by the size of the population in a country.
title: Number of men aged 50–69 with an eating disorder
subtitle: Estimated number of men aged 50–69 who have [an eating disorder](#dod:eating_disorder), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. This only includes anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa. Prevalence is measured as the number experiencing an eating disorder at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
